title: Calm Haven House / ADA Design & Build
text:
Calm Haven House / ADA Design & Build

Calm Haven House was built in 2025. The home belongs to a young couple from the "Land of Coconuts" in the Mekong Delta. They met at university, found a deep connection with each other, and have remained together throughout their journey of dedicating their youth and efforts to the medical profession. As they prepared to welcome their first child, the young doctor couple decided to build their home in the city where they both work. They envisioned a peaceful, tranquil, yet warm and welcoming home—a place where they could relax and recover after the demands of their work.

title: Martha Tavern / CODOO STUDIO
text:
Martha Tavern / CODOO STUDIO

Some bars try to look like homes. With Martha, we decided to do the exact opposite: build a house and open it to the public.

title: House in Belém / Filipe Borges de Macedo
text:
House in Belém / Filipe Borges de Macedo

The dwelling, located in the Casas Económicas das Terras do Forno neighbourhood, inaugurated in 1938 in the parish of Belém, was designed in 1933 by architect Raul Lino. The neighbourhood comprises 204 traditionally designed, low-cost houses intended for civil and military employees, as well as members of the National Trade Unions.

title: Promenade House / studio gm
text:
Promenade House / studio gm

The Promenade House is a residence conceived from the experience of traversing and discovering the landscape. Situated on the shores of a lake and surrounded by an extensive garden, the house does not reveal itself immediately; access occurs along a winding path through the vegetation that gradually leads to the architecture. The path, therefore, is more than mere circulation; it structures the arrival experience, giving rise to the project's name: promenade, in reference to the act of walking and observing.

title: Mirador de Gràcia / Miriam Castells
text:
Mirador de Gràcia / Miriam Castells

The Barcelona-based studio Miriam Castells unveils the interior design for Mirador de Gràcia, a 6,600 m² senior living community nestled on the slopes of the Collserola Natural Park. Positioned right on the border between nature and the city of Barcelona, the project transforms a complex shared-living facility into a space where the human experience takes center stage. The project is grounded in a single core conviction: a senior living residence can—and absolutely must—feel like home.

title: Living Archive / Office ParkScheerbarth
text:
Living Archive / Office ParkScheerbarth

For the first time, 3,400 square meters of previously unused basement beneath a former East Berlin power station opened to the public. For these spaces, Berlin studio Office ParkScheerbarth developed a concept with Tresor founder Dimitri Hegemann for the permanent Living Archive of techno culture he first announced in 2015. The exhibition "Dancefloors After 1989" put it to a full-scale test. For its five-week run, the studio secured the permit and designed the exhibition, using material the building itself supplied.

title: Catching Fog: How Architecture Collects Water from the Air
text:
Catching Fog: How Architecture Collects Water from the Air

Where rivers, reservoirs, and rainfall can no longer be relied upon consistently, water is increasingly being sought in the atmosphere. Fog, atmospheric humidity, and condensation each offer different ways of collecting it. When architecture begins to collect water from the air, surfaces, structures, and open spaces become part of the water system.

title: Harfa Rooftop Extension / matěj šebek architekti
text:
Harfa Rooftop Extension / matěj šebek architekti

How can an urban apartment building be developed without turning it into a developer's product? The revitalisation of an apartment building in Prague's Vysočany offers a different approach to rental housing in Prague.

title: Beijing 1733 ByteDance Commercial Project / XU Studio
text:
Beijing 1733 ByteDance Commercial Project / XU Studio

In highly rational and efficiently operated office parks, how can commercial spaces evolve beyond their role as functional amenities and become shared environments with a sense of life and warmth? The Beijing 1733 Public Space Renovation responds to this question through a strategy of lightweight intervention. Xu Studio revitalized the sunken commercial space and interior themed areas through the insertion of architectural elements, landscape integration, and the reshaping of commercial scenarios, redefining the role of commercial spaces within office campuses.Guided by open interfaces, natural elements, and diverse commercial programs, the design transforms the originally restrained architectural environment into a more vibrant and engaging public space.

title: Sangwich Club / east bureau
text:
Sangwich Club / east bureau

Sangwich Club is a 109.3-square-meter sandwich bar in central Almaty, designed by east bureau as a place that reveals itself gradually. Rather than building the interior around a single visual gesture, the project brings together the existing character of the space, the brand's visual language, and a series of custom-designed elements that echo one another throughout the interior.

title: Dumas Sea Face Masterplan / INI Design Studio
text:
Dumas Sea Face Masterplan / INI Design Studio

For decades, Surat's relationship with the Arabian Sea was shaped by a fragmented and underutilized shoreline. The Dumas Sea Face Masterplan reimagines this edge as a living coastal landscape, transforming a neglected waterfront into a resilient public realm where ecology, civic life, and urban identity converge. Located along the historic Dumas coastline, the project responds to the growing demand for high-quality public open space in one of India's fastest-growing cities. Despite its long-standing cultural and recreational significance, fragmented development, limited accessibility, and the absence of a cohesive vision have constrained the shoreline's potential. The masterplan addresses these challenges by stitching together disparate segments into a continuous waterfront experience that reconnects the city with the sea.

title: AA Apartments / Crearctive
text:
AA Apartments / Crearctive

The project addresses the change of use of commercial premises to transform them into four independent apartments. Taking advantage of the open-plan layout of the original space and its generous clear height of thirteen feet (four meters), the proposal resolves the distribution by designing the void and working in section. The strategy relies on a central spine that groups the service spaces, which optimizes the layout of the building systems, frees up the perimeter of the home, and allows for the articulation of an intermediate level that makes the most of the height of the space.

title: MAGMA House / SUITE
text:
MAGMA House / SUITE

Under the theme "Mind and Heart" of CASACOR São Paulo 2026, Casa MAGMA occupies 215 m² with curves, tactile textures, and earthy tones, proposing an experience of warmth and introspection.

title: Colares Sintra House / Sabrab
text:
Colares Sintra House / Sabrab

Set within a pine forest of stone pines in Colares, overlooking the vineyards and the slopes of the Sintra Mountains, the house is the result of transforming an existing villa into a contemporary living space, open to the garden and the landscape.

title: Shanghai Grand Opera House / Snøhetta
text:
Shanghai Grand Opera House / Snøhetta

Set along the Huangpu River, the Shanghai Grand Opera House emerges as a new cultural landmark for one of the world's most dynamic cities. As an open cultural landscape, it brings together a world-class performing arts venue and an accessible public realm – inviting residents and visitors alike to engage with culture, architecture, and urban life. Rooted in Shanghai's spirit of openness, exchange, and innovation, the project broadens access to culture while creating a new platform for artistic expression and civic engagement.

title: Bunkers and Arks: Escaping the Future We Built Ourselves
text:
Bunkers and Arks: Escaping the Future We Built Ourselves

Inverting the conventional narrative, this story begins at the end. The day after the world's collapse. While almost the entire population struggles to survive flames and solar storms, a tiny fraction is greeted by a heavily armed guard at the entrance to the Survival Condo Project, a former missile silo in Kansas converted a few years ago into luxury apartments.

title: Prague Fire Rescue Service / Architektura
text:
Prague Fire Rescue Service / Architektura

The Prague Fire Rescue Service headquarters complex in Holešovice is conceived as civic infrastructure anchored by a strong urban presence at a highly exposed intersection. The project develops a long-term strategy for the Fire Rescue Service to consolidate its operational and administrative functions within a coherent campus, combining clarity of organisation with a distinctly public architectural expression.

title: HARMAY Changsha Guojin Street Store / STUDIO SPLASH
text:
HARMAY Changsha Guojin Street Store / STUDIO SPLASH

Located on Guojin Street at the core of Changsha's Wuyi Square commercial district, the project sits within an underground retail spine linking street-level entrances with subterranean transit hubs, marked by crisscrossing interior corridors. The HARMAY store occupies the B1 level, bridging the B2 double-height atrium with the north-south ground access routes at a major intersection of pedestrian circulation.

title: CCLM 280 House / Barbalaco Arquitectos
text:
CCLM 280 House / Barbalaco Arquitectos

Located in a residential neighborhood in the Cañuelas district, this weekend home was conceived from the very beginning as a gathering place to share with family and friends.

title: Ella House / Studio Memo
text:
Ella House / Studio Memo

Casa Ella is divided into two blocks around a central garden, connected by a fluid path of ramps that link the zones at every half-level up to a roof garden, gradually revealing the relationships between the home's interior and exterior. It features a sculptural volumetry that embraces, protects, and welcomes, while also enabling multiple connections with the outdoors. Among the design solutions adopted, the project prioritizes the residents' privacy while offering spaces filled with natural light.

title: Pavilion for Good Sleep / WHALE!
text:
Pavilion for Good Sleep / WHALE!

A pavilion for good sleep requires an eastern orientation, to wake up with the morning sun.

title: Gondomar Urban Park / Paulo Merlini arquitetos
text:
Gondomar Urban Park / Paulo Merlini arquitetos

The challenge set out was to create an urban park with a large green area associated with recreational and leisure functions, on a site of approximately 20,000 square metres located in the centre of S. Cosme, which currently served no particular purpose for the city.

title: Central Library at Stevens Ranch  / Miller Hull Partnership + Steele Associates Architects
text:
Central Library at Stevens Ranch / Miller Hull Partnership + Steele Associates Architects

Deschutes County's New Central Library Reimagines What a Library Can Be Designed by Miller Hull and STEELE Associates, the 100,000-square-foot Stevens Ranch library brings together learning, creativity, coworking and community through a mass-timber design. Stevens Ranch, Oregon — A library means something different to everyone. For some, it's a place to do research. Others come to read in peace, to write, to code, to collaborate. The new Central Library at Stevens Ranch in Deschutes County, OR, designed by The Miller Hull Partnership and local architects STEELE Associates, acknowledges these different user groups and welcomes them all. At over 100,000 square feet, the three-story library accommodates the diverse experiences of modern life and learning.

title: Two Multi-Family Housing Units / Aplomb
text:
Two Multi-Family Housing Units / Aplomb

This project involves the construction of two social housing units for SOMCO, the historical social housing provider (bailleur HLM) for the City of Mulhouse, which is widely renowned for its architectural heritage and social commitment. From its very inception, the project brief has demonstrated a strong environmental and eco-responsible ambition.
